2503.19172_fig_6.description: Clifford implementation of NOHE, and its Clifford inversion. (a) Gate-teleportation (GT) implementation of U NOHE P 𝒎 , where P 𝒎 is a random Pauli operator revealed by the outcomes of the Bell measurements (BMs. (b) Although the basic operation | i , j ⟩ → | NOHE ( i , j ) ⟩ is non-Clifford, it can be inverted with a Clifford circuit.
